SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-05: CQL — Type Operators - Structural. Test these items: As<T>(argument), Children(argument), Convert to<T>(argument), Descendants(argument), Is<T>(argument). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §9.8 Is / §9.9 As — Is/As on FHIR resource types from retrieves
issues.evidence: define X: First([Observation]) (also Last, 'singleton from [Observation]', and 'First([Observation]) as Observation') generates definition CTE: SELECT _pt.patient_id, LIST_EXTRACT("Observation", 1) AS resource FROM _patients AS _pt — references the retrieve CTE name as a bare column with no FROM/join. DuckDB Binder Error: Referenced column "Observation" not found. Count([Observation]) works via the _agg_src correlated subquery path in _functions.py:1797; First/Last/singleton-from lack the equivalent. Reproducers: .temp/qa/probe6.py, probe3/4/7.
issues.root_cause: expressions/_functions.py First/Last dispatch (line ~1119) and _apply_singleton_from translate a bare Retrieve argument in LIST usage to a RetrievePlaceholder/CTE identifier used directly inside LIST_EXTRACT without a correlated FROM, unlike the aggregate path which builds a correlated subquery.
issues.resolution: Added _translate_first_last_over_retrieve (expressions/_functions.py) building a per-patient correlated subquery over the retrieve CTE for First/Last; 'singleton from [Retrieve]' now wraps the CTE placeholder in a row subquery routed through _apply_singleton_from's cardinality branch (expressions/_operators.py).

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §22.9 Children / §22.10 Descendants — type testing individual child/descendant elements
issues.evidence: exists ([Observation] O where exists (Descendants(O) D where D is Quantity)) → Binder Error ltrim(VARCHAR[]): the alias D binds to the whole cqlDescendants(...) VARCHAR[] list, not per-item. Over literals: exists (Children({ a: 1, b: 'x' }) C where C is Integer) → False (expected True; Integer 1 is a child), and Descendants({ a: { b: 1 } }) D where D is Integer → False (expected True). Reproducers: probe10.py, probe14.py.
issues.root_cause: Query-source alias binding over Children()/Descendants() list expressions does not unnest per item; the is-check then applies scalar heuristics (LTRIM/typeof) to the list value.
issues.resolution: UNNEST-based per-element iteration for Children()/Descendants() query sources with alias (expressions/_query.py structural handler); element-value aliases no longer qualified with .resource (_alias_is_element_value); _cql_typed_value_type_check accepts _lt_ structural-item aliases; correlation.py no longer adds patient_id correlation to FROM-clause-less unnest subqueries.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix FHIR — FHIR string-family primitives implicitly convert to System.String
issues.evidence: exists ([Observation] O where O.status is String) → False and O.id is FHIR.string → False, though status/id hold string values. Is-check lowers to (status).type().name = 'string', but the FHIRPath runtime reports the FHIR primitive type 'code' for status. Expected: True (FHIR.code/id/uri/... → System.String). Reproducer: probe11.py, probe12.py.
issues.root_cause: _fhirpath_primitive_type_check (expressions/_query.py:2968) only accepts the single canonical name per bare CQL type; no string-family mapping from FHIR primitive type names to System.String.
issues.resolution: Data-driven FHIR->CQL type map externalized in translator/inference.py (FHIR_TYPE_TO_CQL_TYPE + fhir_type_names_for_cql_type); _fhirpath_primitive_type_check and _fhirpath_type_name_check accept FHIR string-family primitives for unqualified/System targets only; static type shortcut and clinical Code routing skipped for FHIR-qualified targets.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §9 Query — list literal as query source with alias
issues.evidence: exists ({1, 2} N where N is Integer) → Binder Error: Referenced table "N" not found (alias N never bound). Reproducer: probe14.py.
issues.root_cause: Query translation over ListExpression sources does not register/unnest the alias for where-clause references.
issues.resolution: exists() over row-subquery list sources now emits EXISTS instead of invalid list_count (expressions/_lists.py); query-source aliases over list literals already unnest; is-check alias resolution no longer appends .resource for element-value aliases.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §22.9 Children — children are the element values, not typed wrappers
issues.evidence: exists (Children({ a: 1, b: 5 }) C where C > 3) fails: tagged structural items ({"__fhir4ds_cql_type":...}) are VARCHAR JSON and DuckDB refuses VARCHAR vs INTEGER comparison. `is`/`as` unwrap correctly; value comparisons do not.
issues.root_cause: Structural item values carry the __fhir4ds_cql_type tag through iteration; comparison lowering has no per-element unwrap for _lt_ structural items.
issues.resolution: Deferred: requires net-new per-element value-unwrap machinery in binary comparison lowering (a wide surface). is/as/Convert — the chunk-mandated operators — are covered.
